summary.lv: inGain, Latvijas B2B fintech SaaS platforma, meklē QA Engineer (Manual & Automation) ar 4+ gadu pieredzi, kurš līdzsvaros manuālo un automatizēto testēšanu un vadīs testēšanas standartus.
summary.en: inGain, a Latvian B2B fintech SaaS platform for lending operations, is seeking a QA Engineer (Manual & Automation) with 4+ years of experience to balance manual and automated testing and guide QA standards company-wide.
